name: Reniel
source: Reniel is one of the Ostmoor Elves. She will pet all the dogs. She will squeal at every cat. Giant monsters with sharp horns and bloodshot eyes? She thinks they're cute. She can't control her magic very well, and in order to wield it she gives it the shape of either a shield or a sword. She always makes the best of what she has.
